page.layout: One column of running text, page 36. Below the last line, at the right, the catchword "cu-". No marginal notes. Ornament dash at the bottom left, not text.

main_text.p: tici vocantur. in quo nostri omnino melius multo,quòd clarissimorum hominū auctoritate leges & iura tecta esse voluerunt. Rectè Antonius. non enim Romani, ité ut Gręci,Iurisconsultorū suo rum munus in tam exili ac tenui opera consumi voluerūt, ut actionibus tantum ac formulis,cautionibusq; præ-essent: sed in æquo bonoque ciuibus omnibus respondēndo. Quocirca præclarè mihi Celsus artē Iuris definisse uidetur, artem æqui & boni: meritoque Iurisconsultos olim maximo semper in honore ac precio habitos fuisse.

page.notes: Each line of the column begins with a printed "»" mark. These recur on every line and are not transcribed; they may be printed line marks rather than text, so check. The running head at the top is decorative and too worn to read; it is marked illegible. "respondēndo" is set with a macron over the n and no printed hyphen; reading uncertain. "ité" has an accent, read as printed. Dash at the bottom left is not text.
